description: Search for royalty-free music tracks and ambient sounds. Quiz forms especially benefit from background music - it keeps energy up between questions. Also consider it for multi-step surveys and longer forms. Pass the returned URL as the audio for the slideshow video template via clipform_render_video_template. Returns download URLs, duration, artist, and license info.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. 'upbeat quiz background', 'calm ambient', 'playful pizzicato')

tags.description: Genre/mood tags to filter by. Multiple tags are ANDed together (e.g. ['ambient', 'chill'] matches tracks tagged both).

name: clipform_search_music

tracks.description: Matching tracks (empty if none); pass a url as the audio for the slideshow template

title: Search Music
